scientific_integrity: General proof via explicit derivation matrices, rank-one commuting dichotomy, and finite-field rational line-plane-flag incidence. Independent finite computations cover q=2,4, not an arbitrary-field proof.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary derivations of the four-dimensional split algebra over characteristic-two fields; rank counts refer to the full underlying four-space; no claim about nonreduced scheme structure or conjugacy orbits. Geometric special cases m=2 and dimension results already established by Levy (2006) and Ngo (2014). No independent priority audit.
title: Rank-resolved commuting square-zero derivations of the Klein-four modular algebra
